name: Jorminous
ability: Swift Swim / Shell Armor / Cursed Body (hidden)
look: a huge coiled sea serpent with a head carved like a longship's dragon prow, round Viking shields along its coils, oar fins fraying into ghostly foam, mast-like spikes and a tail trailing glowing sea mist
entry: The ghost of a sunken raiding ship that has become a great sea serpent. When it rises out of the fog with its shields gleaming and its oars beating, whole fleets turn back to shore.
how: Use a Dusk Stone on Jormbuoy at level 45 or higher. It learns Hex when it evolves.
Wild: very rare on deep oceans at night.
